name: B-value Shell Counts
description: Validates the number of images in each b-value shell against a configurable specification, e.g. '0:5, 1000:45-55, 2000:25' means >=5 b=0 images, 45-55 b~1000 images and >=25 b~2000 images.

testCases.name: Too many b=0 images fail a bounded spec
Min-only spec passes with more images

parameterDefinitions.name: shell_spec
parameterDefinitions.label: Shell specification
parameterDefinitions.description: Comma-separated 'center:min' or 'center:min-max' image counts per shell

parameterDefinitions.name: shell_tolerance
parameterDefinitions.label: Shell tolerance
parameterDefinitions.description: b-values within ± this of a shell center belong to that shell
